name: @xlmtools/mcp

tools.name: crypto
tools.description: Get real-time cryptocurrency prices, market caps, and 24h changes. Free.

tools.name: weather
tools.description: Current weather and conditions for any city. Free.

location.description: City name (e.g. Lagos, London, New York)

tools.name: domain
tools.description: Check if a domain name is available. Free.

tools.name: tools
tools.description: List all XLMTools tools with their per-call cost in USDC.

tools.name: wallet
tools.description: Show your Stellar wallet address, current USDC balance, and how to fund it. Free.

tools.name: budget
tools.description: Set, check, or clear a spending limit for this session. The budget resets when the MCP server restarts. Cached responses do not count against the budget.

action.description: Action: set a limit, check status, or clear limit

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Search the web and news in real-time. Returns results with source URLs.
Cost: $0.003 USDC per search (paid via Stellar MPP).

tools.name: research
tools.description:
Deep research on any topic — returns summarized, sourced results from multiple web pages.
Cost: $0.010 USDC per query (paid via Stellar MPP).

tools.name: youtube
tools.description:
Search YouTube videos or look up a specific video by ID. Provide either query or id.
Cost: $0.002 USDC per call (paid via Stellar MPP).

id.description: YouTube video ID for direct lookup

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description:
Capture a screenshot of any public URL and return it as an image.
Cost: $0.010 USDC per screenshot (paid via Stellar MPP).

url.description: URL of the page to screenshot

tools.name: scrape
tools.description:
Extract clean text content from any public URL.
Cost: $0.002 USDC per scrape (paid via Stellar MPP).

url.description: URL of the page to scrape

tools.name: image
tools.description:
Generate images from a text prompt using AI.
Cost: $0.040 USDC per image (paid via Stellar MPP).

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate

tools.name: stocks
tools.description:
Get real-time stock price and market data for any ticker symbol.
Cost: $0.001 USDC per query (paid via Stellar MPP).

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, TSLA, MSFT)

tools.name: dex-orderbook
tools.description:
View the live orderbook for any Stellar asset pair. Shows bids, asks, and spread.
Use pairs like "XLM/USDC", "USDC/EURC", or "CODE:ISSUER/XLM".
Well-known assets: XLM, USDC, EURC, AQUA, yUSDC, BLND, SHX.
Free.

limit.description: Number of price levels per side (1-200)

tools.name: dex-candles
tools.description:
Get OHLCV candlestick price data for any Stellar asset pair.
Resolutions: 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 1d, 1w.
Examples: "XLM/USDC" at "1h", "USDC/EURC" at "1d".
Free.

tools.name: dex-trades
tools.description:
Get recent trades for any Stellar asset pair.
Filter by trade type: "all", "orderbook", or "liquidity_pool".
Free.

tools.name: swap-quote
tools.description:
Find the best swap path between any two Stellar assets using the native DEX.
Shows rate, path hops, and slippage tips.
Examples: swap 100 XLM to USDC, swap 50 USDC to EURC.
Well-known assets: XLM, USDC, EURC, AQUA, yUSDC, BLND, SHX.
Free.

mode.description: "send" = you fix what you send; "receive" = you fix what you get

tools.name: stellar-asset
tools.description:
Look up any Stellar asset: supply, trustlines, rating, issuer org, and more.
Combines on-chain data (Horizon) with analytics (StellarExpert).
Examples: "USDC", "AQUA", "yUSDC", or "CODE:ISSUER".
Free.

tools.name: stellar-account
tools.description:
Look up any Stellar account: balances, trustlines, signers, and status.
Provide a Stellar public key (starts with G, 56 characters).
Free.

tools.name: stellar-pools
tools.description:
Browse Stellar liquidity pools. Optionally filter by asset.
Shows reserves, shares, trustlines, and fees.
Free.

asset.description: Filter by asset (e.g. "XLM", "USDC"). Omit for all pools.

tools.name: oracle-price
tools.description:
Get real-time prices from Reflector, Stellar's decentralized oracle.
Feeds: "crypto" (BTC, ETH, SOL, etc.), "fiat" (EUR, GBP, JPY), "dex" (Stellar DEX pairs).
Prices are updated every 5 minutes via multi-node consensus.
Free.
